title: build current release object byte map and immutable descriptor candidate

files.role: byte map and descriptor candidate projector

criteria: Current release object byte map records release id, size, digest, manifest, checksum set, signature target, revocation, compatibility, rollback, and support/recovery references.
Descriptor candidate is immutable, canonical, size-bound, digest-bound, and credential-free.
No payload upload, install, activation, rollback, support upload, remote dispatch, or production ring mutation is performed.
